# JayDubb Tha Ruler

> Official website and authoritative knowledge base for JayDubb Tha Ruler, independent hip-hop artist, songwriter, and founder of The 7 from Colorado Springs, Colorado.

## Primary Content & Canonical URLs

- [Official Website](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/): Comprehensive artist hub, latest releases, video catalog, live history, biography, press reviews, The 7 apparel, and booking.
- [Aquarium Floors Visual & Single](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/releases/aquarium-floors): Official music video, track narrative, production credits, and streaming links.
- [Shake It Bae Single](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/releases/shake-it-bae): 2026 headline single featuring LLzMusik, streaming links, and background.
- [Don't Forget the Bag Album](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/releases/dont-forget-the-bag): 2025 full-length studio project, tracklist, and platforms.
- [Off Brand Single (feat. WESTSIDE BOOGIE)](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/releases/off-brand): Acclaimed 2022 collaboration with Compton rapper WESTSIDE BOOGIE, covered by Westword and 303 Magazine.
- [Music Catalog](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#music): Full chronological discography spanning 2018–2026.
- [Live Performance History](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#live): Tour destinations across Colorado, Florida, and Germany; opening support for Kid Ink, Kirko Bangz, Paul Wall, Baby Bash, Fetty Wap, and Caskey.
- [Biography & Origins](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#story): Formative poetry roots (Edgar Allan Poe, Langston Hughes), grief transformed into art, and independent trajectory.
- [Press & Reviews](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#press): Featured in Westword, 303 Magazine, and VoyageDenver.
- [The 7 Brand & Merch](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#the-7): Independent apparel and culture line available at https://www.the7even.co/
- [Booking & Management](https://jaydubbtharuler.com/#contact): Direct contact for concert booking, festival inquiries, brand partnerships, and press.

## Key Verified Facts

- **Stage Name:** JayDubb Tha Ruler (also stylized as JayDubb, JayDubbThaRuler)
- **Legal Name:** Justin Wallace
- **Hometown / Origin:** Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States
- **Genre:** Hip-Hop / Rap / Independent Hip-Hop
- **Poetic Roots:** Began rapping at 13; influenced early on by Edgar Allan Poe and Langston Hughes (reworking "Harlem" into "What Happens to a Love Concealed").
- **Catalyst:** Dedicated himself to music after the passing of a close friend during his senior year in high school.
- **Debut Project:** *The Year of the 7* (8-track album, released 2018).
- **Subsequent Projects & Singles:**
  - *Shake It Bae* (Single feat. LLzMusik, 2026)
  - *Don't Forget the Bag* (Studio Album, 2025)
  - *Plain Jane* (Single, 2025)
  - *Wyd* (Single, 2025)
  - *Did It My Way* (Single feat. Skeme, 2024)
  - *Get Back to It* (EP, 2023)
  - *Off Brand* (Single feat. WESTSIDE BOOGIE, 2022)
  - Collaborative works with am.wav, City Hollow, and Caskey.
- **Live Stages:** Colorado, Florida, Germany.
- **Opened For:** Kid Ink, Kirko Bangz, Paul Wall, Baby Bash, Trev Rich, Caskey, Fetty Wap, T-Rell, YBN Nahmir, YFN Lucci.
- **Booking / Press Email:** booking@jaydubbtharuler.com
- **Official Merch Store:** https://www.the7even.co/
